_comment: StrykerJS mutation testing for @ariada-org/scan-report-html. Scoped narrowly to src/score.ts (the pure-function compliance scorer) to prove the per-package opt-in pattern; broader scope is a future increment.
_mutate_scope_note_comment: POC scope: src/score.ts only — 4 pure functions (computeComplianceScore, bandFromScore, topActionItems, severityBreakdown). Excluded for now: render.ts (string concatenation; equivalent-mutant heavy), styles.ts (string template), index.ts (re-exports only).
